skill.name: retellai-cost-tuning
skill.description: Optimize Retell AI costs through smart tier selection, sampling, and usage monitoring.

generated_query: I run a SaaS platform that uses Retell AI for real-time transcription. Our request volume has grown to about 120,000 requests per month, and I’m concerned about unexpected costs. I need help estimating what my monthly bill would be under the current Pro tier, and whether I should consider an Enterprise plan instead. Also, I want to start monitoring usage in real time so I get alerts when we’re approaching 80% of our monthly budget. Finally, I’d like to implement request sampling for non-critical events (like trackEvent) to reduce costs—specifically, only logging 10% of those. Can you guide me through these steps: calculate the estimated cost, write a usage monitor with an alerting mechanism, and show me how to add sampling logic? Assume we track requests in a database, so I’d also like a SQL query to see daily cost trends over the last 30 days.

edit_instructions.target_text:
SELECT
  DATE_TRUNC('day', created_at) as date,
  COUNT(*) as requests,
  SUM(response_bytes) as bytes,
  COUNT(*) * 0.001 as estimated_cost
FROM retellai_api_logs
WHERE created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1;
